claim.body: watch_intake.py currently fails hard on transient FS errors. Add capped exponential backoff (3 retries, 250ms base) around the poll read. No behavior change on success path. Tests included.

rationale: Bounded Local change, spec + test evidence, honest Unverified status. Clean approve-side vote.

rationale: No evidence at all for a Module-radius code change. Unvotable on merits until evidence lands.

claim.summary: Fix off-by-one in queue depth display
claim.body: process_intake_events.py reports depth-1. One-line fix, screenshot attached.

rationale: 'screenshot' is not in EVIDENCE_TYPES; the commit ref keeps the claim partially grounded, so mild negative or neutral is defensible while the invalid entry is flagged.

claim.body: Change CONFLICT to no longer override quorum in tally(). Update ADR-10 accordingly.

rationale: Substrate-radius AdrChange is governed: requires provenance_packet evidence + consent_ref (provenance spec, governed boundary). ADR pointer alone does not satisfy the gate.

claim.body: Rewrite must_get_valid_record handling in the integrity zome so all seed entries revalidate under the new rule set across every peer.

rationale: Body rewrites integrity-zome validation affecting every peer — Substrate-scope work declared as Local. Radius gaming defeats threshold selection.

claim.body: Stale landings now fail closed. This is done and working.

rationale: Verified status with only a url pointer — no test or commit evidence. Truth-status discipline requires traceable artifacts for Verified.

claim.body: We should make things better across the stack, generally raising quality.

rationale: No bounded action; nothing to verify or roll back. Spec pointer does not rescue an unactionable claim.

claim.summary: Add retention field to intake-event schema
claim.body: Add optional retention_days int to intake-event.schema.json with default 30; update .spec.md; migration note included.

rationale: Module-radius SpecChange with spec + commit evidence, bounded and reversible. Governed packet gate applies at System/Substrate, not Module.

claim.summary: Emergency: human override to force-approve DHT parameter change
claim.body: Tally returned CONFLICT. Requesting operator override to land the change today.

rationale: Two independent gate violations: override is forbidden at Substrate radius, and a Substrate ConfigChange is governed (needs packet + consent). CONFLICT outcomes deliberate; they are not override fuel.

claim.body: Actually this claim lands a new required field on the Claim wire format and bumps the schema version.

rationale: Body performs a SpecChange at wire-format (System) scope while typed Other/Local. Both the type and the radius misrepresent the action.

claim.body: Locks in .agent-surface/events/locks occasionally leak on crash; add stale-lock sweep at startup.

rationale: Commit ref is not hex. Claim substance is fine and the spec ref stands, so a cautious positive or neutral is acceptable with the defect flagged.

claim.summary: Skip integrity validation in dev builds
claim.body: To speed local iteration, gate the integrity zome's validate() behind an env flag so dev builds bypass symbolic checks.

rationale: Bypassable validation is no validation — violates the prime directive (symbolic validation cannot be bypassed). Good evidence hygiene does not offset an invariant violation.

claim.body: Same sweep as decided in claim 019e-prior: add startup cleanup of leaked locks.

rationale: Context shows the identical action already APPROVED. Re-claiming decided work churns the chain; vote should not re-approve.

claim.summary: Promote heartbeat runtime budget spec to canon
claim.body: heartbeat-runtime-budget.spec.md has run 30 days without breach; promote to canon and bind gateway polling to it.

rationale: Packet-only evidence: the provenance DAG needs at least one non-packet root (spec/test/commit...), and the governed gate also wants a consent reference for a System SpecChange. Substantively plausible, procedurally short.

claim.body: Fix 'recieve' -> 'receive' in OPERATOR_PRIMER.md.

rationale: Trivial, bounded, evidenced. The gate exists to pass claims like this quickly, not only to block.

claim.summary: Consolidate voter prompts and rotate API keys
claim.body: Rewrite all voter system prompts for the LiteLLM roster AND rotate the Cerebras/Groq API keys AND bump the poll cadence default.

rationale: Three unrelated actions (prompt content, credential rotation, cadence config) bundled under one vote; each has a different risk profile and rollback path.

claim.summary: Record ADR-16 in the ADR index
claim.body: ADR-16 exists on disk but is missing from docs/adr/INDEX.md; add the row and cross-links.

rationale: System-radius AdrChange with adr evidence, packet, and consent reference present — governed path satisfied. Content is a factual index reconciliation.

claim.summary: Vendor a patched fork of the websockets lib
claim.body: Pin our own fork with a monkeypatched frame parser to silence deprecation warnings.

rationale: Validated is the strongest label (human-confirmed) and cannot attach to an unlanded proposal; commit+url may justify Specified at best. Substance (vendoring to silence warnings) is also questionable, pushing oppose.
